# Negative stream tests should fail on unexpected success

The accepted local malformed-mbox tests check the error only inside catch blocks, so those assertions are skipped if streamMessage and its promise unexpectedly succeed. The telemetry assertion supplies a separate counter check, but it does not replace an explicit rejection assertion for every read. For this test family, recommend Assert.rejects or an explicit failure on the success path. This is a static test-gap observation and a proposed improvement; it is not a reproduced product defect or a claim that reviewers accepted the recommendation. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: Mbox malformed-stream tests.
